title: Stormlog Studio report v1
description: GET /api/v1/report?path= (design §5.4), written by workspace.read_report: one stormlog.report v1 envelope under the workspace root, at most 16 MiB, checked by report.validate_report. report is that envelope after contracts.to_wire, so it differs from stormlog_report_v1.schema.json on exactly one point: integers under *_ns keys, and integers beyond 2^53 - 1, are decimal strings (§5.1). NaN and infinities are null, listed in non_finite_fields.

path.description: Root-relative POSIX path of the report file.

report.description: The stormlog.report v1 envelope in wire form.

non_finite_fields.description: Paths that held NaN or an infinity, now null (contracts.finite_copy).
